Central Bank of India Faculty Result 2026 OUT – Check Selection List

You are a Senior React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, and UI/UX Engineer.

Your task is to completely redesign my existing PostPage.tsx component into a premium-quality, production-ready blog/article page.

IMPORTANT RULES (MUST FOLLOW)

• Do NOT remove any existing functionality.

• Do NOT break routing.

• Do NOT change data structure.

• Do NOT rename post properties.

• Do NOT modify ALL_POSTS.

• Keep React Helmet SEO working.

• Keep useParams(), useScroll(), motion animations.

• Keep Related Posts functionality.

• Keep Copy Link functionality.

• Keep Share Buttons functionality.

• Keep Tags functionality.

• Keep Category functionality.

• Keep Dark Mode support.

• Keep Responsive Design.

• Keep all existing imports unless replacing with a better implementation.

====================================================

GOAL

Transform this page into a premium article page similar to:

• Google Discover

• Medium

• Apple News

• Modern News Websites

The design should feel elegant, minimal, premium, modern, and extremely professional.
